+def slerp(q0, q1, u):
+    q0 = np.asarray(q0, float); q1 = np.asarray(q1, float)

+    dot = float(q0 @ q1)

+def move_pose(pos, quat=None, grip=None, spacing=0.012, angle_step=0.06, note="move"):
+    """Move TCP along a straight, finely sampled pose path; target pose uses wxyz."""
